crossRefs.note: For I will declare my iniquity. I will be sorry for my sin.
Those who sow in tears will reap in joy.
He who goes out weeping, carrying seed for sowing, will certainly come again with joy, carrying his sheaves.
Out of the depths I have cried to you, Yahweh.
Hear my prayer, Yahweh. Listen to my petitions. In your faithfulness and righteousness, relieve me.
“I have surely heard Ephraim grieving thus, ‘You have chastised me, and I was chastised, as an untrained calf. Turn me…
But those of those who escape, they will escape and will be on the mountains like doves of the valleys, all of them…
I will pour on David’s house, and on the inhabitants of Jerusalem, the spirit of grace and of supplication; and they…
Blessed are those who mourn, for they shall be comforted.
Peter remembered the word which Jesus had said to him, “Before the rooster crows, you will deny me three times.” Then…
The rooster crowed the second time. Peter remembered the word, how that Jesus said to him, “Before the rooster crows…
Therefore let him who thinks he stands be careful that he doesn’t fall.
I now rejoice, not that you were grieved, but that you were grieved to repentance. For you were grieved in a godly way…
